title: LoadThreadedRequest can crash when loading the same subresource as another thread
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: 4.5.1, 4.6.2 ### System information Godot v4.6.2.stable (001aa128b) - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated The occurrence rate of this crash is fairly low, and none of our team can reproduce it. That's the basic issue description. But I started looking into it and I think I've narrowed down the main cause of the issue. I'm going to post another comment down below shortly, describing what I've found. ### Steps to reproduce As noted above, this issue is quite difficult to reproduce, so I'll leave it to the MRP below. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) Here is the Godot project containing an asset setup and script which can reproduce the problem **on my machine**, on 4.6.2 stable: [ltr-crash-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26418724/ltr-crash-mrp.zip) When running this project, I see errors like this spammed in the debugger. At some point, the player closes abruptly, indicating a native crash. However, the problem is thread-timing dependent. It doesn't always happen, and depends heavily on the hardware of the machine. In the context of our real project, I managed to produce a timing which exhibited the problem by inserting calls to `sleep` like shown here: https://github.com/Chaosed0/godot/commit/20f2b593193a605b3928d09fd6e50dc386112d79 This may be necessary for your machine and your setup to reproduce the issue.
